Controls

Aim
Drag the launcher: sideways turns it, up and down moves the peg. Or tap the map to point it there.
Roll
Grab the launcher by its wheels and drag sideways.
Pump / fire
Tap the hand pump (hold to keep pumping). Tap the blue valve handle to fire.
Look around
Two fingers on the field, or right-drag / Shift-drag; the mouse wheel zooms.
Map
⤢ makes it bigger. Pinch it or use the mouse wheel over it to zoom. Drag the red dotted line to aim. Drag anywhere else to move the map about (when there's more of it to see); a tap aims there (a pin shows how far).

How to play
👆
How to play

The object

Score as high as you can with a limited supply of spuds. Hit all four colours, orange 10, purple 15, blue 20 and red 25, to clear the level: +30, and on to the next.

Cart Launcher levels (Pasture, Cul de sac, Lake, Harvest)

  • Load a spud, pump up the pressure (more PSI goes farther), set the angle on the peg board and the rotation, then press OPEN (it opens the valve) to launch. Or work the cart by touch: tap the pump, drag the cart to aim, tap the blue valve to launch. On some levels it rolls sideways on its wheels.
  • Rings each score once. Some are spinners, targets on a tree or bale, or up on a roof.
  • The map (bottom right) shows the field from above. Drag its red dotted line to turn the cart, or tap the map where you want to aim. Rings show in their colours, bonus objects as green squares, animals and people as orange, your landings as dots.
  • Objects in the field (the junker, the mailbox, the tractor…) are a +10 bonus, once each. Animals and people cost 10 every time.
  • Two or more scores with one spud is a combo bonus.
  • One Shot Bonus: hit all of a level's bonus objects (they're crossed off at the top as you go) to earn a glowing golden spud, an extra. The cart is set on a golden arch of six stars: just find the pressure. +20 a star, 120 for all six. Calm air for that one, and nothing else counts.
  • Wind pushes the spud: the arrow on the map shows it.
  • Ten spuds a level. Clear every ring and each spare spud is +1.

MP levels (Skeetza, Milling, Reservoir)

  • Grab a loaded MP from its cabinet: the MP 10 has two barrels, the Reservoir's MP 15 three. Aim with the mouse or a finger; launch with OPEN, a click or Space.
  • Skeet fly up in pairs (threes at the Reservoir). Plain ones are 5; coloured ones are worth their colour's points. Hit one of each colour to clear the level; then spare barrels and pulls not used are +1 each.
  • Calls: both of a pair with one barrel (Two Fer), both with a barrel each (Double), both and the drone (Amazing Triple).
  • The drone (and each level's own bonuses) are a bonus; workers, windows and animals cost 10.
  • UP mode: hit all of a level's bonuses to earn 30 s of UNLIMITED PNEUMAN. Hold OPEN to keep launching; waves of skeet worth 1 each, doubles +2, triples +5, quadruples +10.

Everywhere

  • Difficulty: meh, yup or gnarly, beside Play or in Settings. Harder means smaller, farther targets, more wind, and more in the way; your total is ×1, ×1.1 or ×1.2.
  • Re-live it plays your last shot again; Share sends a postcard of it. At the end, Challenge a friend to the same round: one try each.
  • Keys: arrows aim, Space pumps (or launches on the MP levels), Enter loads and launches, B bleeds, A and D roll the cart, M mutes.

Start over?

Skeetza tip

Two thumbs, like a pro

Tapping the field to launch with the finger that aims nudges the sights off target. Keep one thumb steering low and launch with the other. Left-handed? Flip it: the left OPEN, and slide on the right.
